form.title: Tell us about you
form.full_name_help: Write your name as it is on your Aadhaar or caste certificate.
form.mobile_help: 10-digit Indian mobile. We will not send a real SMS in this demo.
form.state_help: Your home state. Caste lists differ by state, so this must match your certificate.
form.district_help: The district written on your address proof.
form.pin_help: 6-digit postal PIN. We use it to place you on the map.
form.caste_category_help: NSFDC windows are for Scheduled Caste applicants. Other categories are shown only as a reminder to check the right corporation.
form.age_help: Your age in completed years. Most schemes need 18 to 55 or 60.
form.annual_family_income_help: Total income of your family in one year. Many schemes stop at Rs 5 lakh. Enter numbers only, like 300000.
form.applicant_type_help: Apply as one person, or as a Self Help Group.
form.sector_help: What kind of work will the loan support?
form.project_description_help: In two or three lines, what will you do with the money?
form.loan_amount_help: How much loan you want. Not the full project cost.
form.project_cost_help: Total cost of the unit or course, including your own money.
form.woman_led_help: Tick if the applicant or the group leader is a woman. Some schemes are only for women.
form.disability_help: Tick if you have a valid disability certificate.
form.sanitation_worker_help: Tick if you or your family work in sanitation. Extra help may apply.
form.skill_certificate_help: Tick if you have a skill certificate. It can support training-linked loans.
form.shg_jlg_member_help: Tick if you already save with a group. Micro-credit is often easier this way.
form.jan_dhan_help: Tick if you have a Jan Dhan bank account.
form.existing_govt_loan_help: Tick if you already have a government loan that is not closed. A second loan may be refused.

paths.title: How will you apply?
paths.offlineHelp: Visit the office with papers. We will show partners on a map.
paths.bankHelp: Follow the steps on the bank website. Videos below are placeholders.
paths.govtHelp: Some schemes also open on a government site. Link is demo-only.
stepsBank: Keep Aadhaar, caste certificate and project papers as photos.
Open the bank portal on a computer if the phone page is hard to use.
Fill the form slowly. Do not guess numbers.
Upload clear photos. Dark or cut photos get sent back.
Note the acknowledgement number and come back here to track.
stepsGovt: Confirm the scheme name on the government site.
Create a login only on the official website.
Fill the same facts you entered here.
Download the receipt and save it on your phone.
